description:
The Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivah Yojana Madhya Pradesh (MKVYMP) is a welfare scheme launched by the Government of Madhya Pradesh. 

The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for the marriage of girls from economically weaker sections. 

The objective is to reduce the financial burden on families and promote the marriage of girls. 

Under this scheme, eligible beneficiaries receive a one-time financial assistance of INR 51,000 for the marriage of their daughters. 

Eligibility criteria include being a resident of Madhya Pradesh and belonging to a below-poverty-line family. 

The girl must be at least 18 years old at the time of marriage. 

The application process involves submitting an application form along with required documents to the local government office or online through the official portal. 

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Women and Child Development, Madhya Pradesh. 

The financial assistance is provided once the marriage is registered and the application is processed. 

The scheme is available throughout the year. 

Additional details include the requirement of a marriage certificate and income certificate for the application.
